When where papers retracted? see @retraction-scatterplot.

```{python}
#| label: retraction-scatterplot
#| fig-cap: "A scatterplot of retracted papers"

import pandas
import os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

datafolder = "data/"
csvfile = "retraction_watch.csv"

df = pandas.read_csv(os.path.join(datafolder, csvfile))

df.dropna(subset=['RetractionDate', 'OriginalPaperDate'], inplace=True)

df.head()
df['RetractionDate'] = pandas.to_datetime(df['RetractionDate'], format='mixed')
df['OriginalPaperDate'] = pandas.to_datetime(df['OriginalPaperDate'], format='mixed')

plot_df = df.dropna(subset=['RetractionDate', 'OriginalPaperDate', 'Country'])
top_countries = plot_df['Country'].value_counts().head(10).index
plot_df = plot_df[plot_df['Country'].isin(top_countries)]

colors = dict(zip(top_countries, plt.cm.tab10.colors))
ax = None
for country, country_df in plot_df.groupby('Country'):
  ax = country_df.plot.scatter(
    'OriginalPaperDate',
    'RetractionDate',
    label=country,
    color=colors[country],
    alpha=0.6,
    grid=True,
    ax=ax,
  )
ax.legend(title='Country')
```
